description: Reset each turn, then block assistant prose that fails hard AI Sloppy Copy rules.

hooks.command: ROOT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; if [ "${OS:-}" = "Windows_NT" ] && command -v py >/dev/null 2>&1; then py -3 "$ROOT/scripts/hook_ai_sloppy_copy.py"; elif command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "$ROOT/scripts/hook_ai_sloppy_copy.py"; elif command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1; then python "$ROOT/scripts/hook_ai_sloppy_copy.py"; fi
hooks.commandWindows: $root = if ($env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT) { $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT } else { $env:PLUGIN_ROOT }; if ($root) { if (Get-Command py -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { py -3 (Join-Path $root 'scripts\hook_ai_sloppy_copy.py') } elseif (Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { python (Join-Path $root 'scripts\hook_ai_sloppy_copy.py') } }
